title: PARSA-Bench: A Comprehensive Persian Audio-Language Model Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2603.14456v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Persian poses unique audio understanding challenges through its classical poetry, traditional music, and pervasive code-switching, none of which is captured by existing benchmarks. We introduce \textbf{PARSA-Bench} (\textbf{P}ersian \textbf{A}udio \textbf{R}easoning and \textbf{S}peech \textbf{A}ssessment Benchmark), the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating LALMs on Persian language and culture. It covers 16 tasks, ten of them new, spanning speech understanding, paralinguistic analysis, and culturally grounded audio reasoning. Across most tasks, text-only baselines outperform their audio counterparts, so audio understanding rather than language knowledge remains the main limitation, and supplying the transcript alongside the audio lifts weak models to near their text-only level. translated_title: PARSA-Bench：一个全面的波斯语音频-语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 波斯语凭借其古典诗歌、传统音乐和普遍存在的语码转换现象，带来了独特的音频理解挑战，而这些内容均未被现有基准测试所涵盖。我们提出了PARSA-Bench（波斯语音频推理与语音评估基准），这是首个专门用于评估大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）在波斯语语言和文化方面表现的基准测试。它涵盖16项任务，其中10项为全新任务，涉及语音理解、副语言分析以及基于文化背景的音频推理。在大多数任务中，纯文本基线模型的表现优于其音频对应模型，因此音频理解而非语言知识仍然是主要瓶颈；而为模型同时提供音频及其转录文本，可以将较弱的模型性能提升至接近其纯文本水平。一个一致的例外是波斯语诗歌，其韵律承载着书面文字无法传达的信息：在两项诗歌任务上，音频输入均优于文本输入，且韵律……
tldr: 提出首个专门评估大型音频-语言模型在波斯语语言和文化上表现的基准测试PARSA-Bench，涵盖16项任务，揭示音频理解（而非语言知识）是当前模型的主要瓶颈，且波斯语诗歌因韵律信息成为音频优于文本的独特例外。
en_tdlr: PARSA-Bench is the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating Large Audio-Language Models on Persian language and culture across 16 tasks, revealing that audio understanding rather than language knowledge remains the main limitation, with Persian poetry standing out as the unique exception where audio outperforms text due to prosodic information.
